description_full: MiniMax Group Inc. engages in research and development of an artificial intelligence (AI) foundation model. The company's platform offers a wide range of modalities, including language, video, speech, and music. It also provides AI-based enterprise services; AI-native products, including enterprise-facing open platform; and consumer products, such as MiniMax Agent, Hailuo AI, Talkie and Xingye. The company was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
ceo_bio: Dr. Junjie  Yan | Founder, Executive Chairman, CTO & CEO | Age 35 | Compensation: $241,000 (FY2025)
culture_narrative: Employs approximately 568 people. Revenue per employee of $139K ranks in the bottom quartile among Technology peers. Stock-based compensation of $42K per employee reflects an ownership culture. CEO compensation is 2× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). R&D investment of 320% of revenue (heavy) signals commitment to product development and talent. Note: heavy R&D investment has not yet translated to above-average workforce productivity — watch for commercialisation lag.
financial_summary: MiniMax Group Inc. is a large-cap technology business with a $13.3B market cap on $79M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +378% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Gross margins of 12% are the starting point for assessing pricing power.

On the balance sheet, thin -478.3× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 3.2% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and stock-based comp at 30% of revenue is silent dilution an owner has to account for, and insiders hold 35% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
